scope: Typed records, registration, callback storage, compiled GPIO reads, open configuration/error handling, close ordering and shared-pin IRQ callback dispatch compared with stock
limitations: Open/close nrfx calls are intercepted at SDK seams; SDK internals remain untested by this oracle.
nrfx disable/uninit are intercepted only at the final SDK seam; their internal behavior is not tested here.
Newlib strcmp is a binary test dependency.
Electrical behavior, interrupts and complete application startup remain unproven.
